description: This file defines the 'CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint' class which implements a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog items with pagination, filtering, and DTO mapping in a web application.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Implements a minimal API endpoint for returning a paged list of catalog items with filtering.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the GET route 'api/catalog-items' for this endpoint, handling query parameters for pagination and filtering.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request to retrieve a filtered and paginated list of catalog items, mapping entities to DTOs, and composing picture URIs.
